effects.effect: If the mind healer is [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed), [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened), or [taunted](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/taunted), they can end one of those conditions and impose the same condition on one enemy in the area. Additionally, they can do the same for their mentor if the mentor is in the area and is [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed), [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened), or [taunted](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/taunted).
